Prototype 10 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (56%), with EOG (37%) and EMG (7%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+0.4 dB, sensitivity=8.7) and suppressed γ (-1.0 dB, sensitivity=4.6).
The δ activity is present in 21% of each epoch (transient), with quiescent eye movements (SEM 21% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with N2 physiology: confirmed: σ elevated, EOG quiescent; missing: σ relevant.
